Name: MiMi's Lazy Retro Earthy Pixel ReShade Preset
Author: tofuuHaus
Description:
Inspired by golden soil, mellow skies and warmth of old games

Perfect for players who don't want to use several tilesheets recolor and like peaceful earthy tone with a little pixel fuzz to keep things feeling nostalgic.

Made with love and lore in a lazy morning.

---

This isn't a mod—it's more like a filter applied to the entire game. However, you’ll need to install the ReShade program first.

Installation Guide

1. Download ReShade from this link:
https://reshade.me/

2. Double-click the downloaded file > Select Stardew Valley > Choose OpenGL and install it completely. You’ll see a reshade_shaders folder appear in the game’s installation location.

3. Download my files from Nexus and extract them.

4. Open the extracted folder—you’ll see a folder called reshade_shaders (just like the one from the installation). Copy and paste it into your game’s installation folder, overwrite if asked. You should now see a preset file named MiMi... and a lut.png file (like a Lightroom preset) inside the Textures folder.

5. Launch the game normally. When the ReShade installation message appears, just continue until it’s done. Press the Home key on your keyboard, then select the MiMi... preset from the top dropdown. Click Reload at the bottom, and optionally hit Save. All settings are preconfigured, so the next time you launch the game, you won’t have to do anything—your game's color will already be changed to the new look.
